cohort_rule: Keep registered subset pairs only when the published MLC is observed; require exact binary agreement with MLC > 0. Never turn missing MLC into a negative.
alias_rule: Uppercase and remove hyphens; require a unique match in every source. Preserve an explicit alias table.

grouping.rule: Connected components of pairs with core distance strictly below the threshold or identical canonical assembled sequence content; no group crosses partitions.
grouping.assembly_digest: SHA-256 of sorted per-contig SHA-256 digests; each contig is uppercase and canonicalized against its reverse complement. Headers and contig order are ignored. Different fragmentation is not equated.

split.order: FNV-1a of seed:lexicographically-smallest-host-in-group; largest-remainder allocation by group count
split.scope: Development evaluation on unseen host groups with known phage identities; no independent release holdout is claimed.

features.defense_counts: All named subtype count columns from the pinned published DefenseFinder table; complete finite non-negative counts required.

preprocessing.counts: Training-only standardization; constant columns use scale 1
preprocessing.categorical: Training-only one-hot vocabulary; missing is explicit; unseen categories have no active training-category indicator

estimator.kind: One L2 logistic regression per known phage
estimator.selection: Fixed before fitting; no hyperparameter search or evaluation-driven feature changes

evaluation.primary: Pooled test average-precision difference: host-aware minus phage prevalence
evaluation.bootstrap_unit: Held-out host group, paired across models; known phage panel fixed
evaluation.improvement_rule: Lower bound of the paired percentile interval must exceed zero
evaluation.single_class_resample: Omit and report the count; do not substitute a zero score

output_semantics: Uncalibrated scores for published source-coded MLC positivity. No productive-infection probability, mixture effect or clinical efficacy claim.
